Walk-in Interview for the Post of Physical Education (Guest Faculty)
Walk-in-Interview for appointing one (01) Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty)
in Physical Education to teach undergraduate classes in the College will be held on
18.09.2025 (Thursday) at 01.15 PM for the academic session 2025-26 at Rajiv Gandhi College
Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time of
interview. The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in.forms.php and the same is to be submitted by 11.00 AM to the
office staff of the College at the venue on the date of the interview.
Qualifications as laid down by Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview
Sunil Khosla
Principal
